items.description: Map repository modules, hidden tooling, and artifact flow for the Kakeya planning workspace
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/repo_map.md` that names and explains `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `results/literature/`, `results/swarm/`, `results/verification/`, `figures/`, the missing `results/concept_evolve/tree/`, and any verifier/helper-script entry points or their absence; include one dependency graph from literature ingest to swarm decisions to verification.
items.notes: Mapped repo structure, confirmed absence of any exact witness verifier, patched concept_evolve evolve() signature bug, and launched the mandatory ConceptEvolve run; at close only .state/.debug outputs existed under results/concept_evolve.

items.description: Sync saved context and director constraints before any baseline work
items.acceptance_criteria: Read `results/research_context.md`, `results/literature/prior_art_watchlist.md`, `results/literature/novelty_guard.json`, `results/literature/gap_frontier.md`, `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md`, `results/literature/semantic_scholar_manifest.json`, `results/swarm/director_brief.md`, `results/swarm/hypotheses.json`, and `results/swarm/tool_plan.md`; write `results/context_sync.md` summarizing the active lane (`H1`), the malformed-watchlist caveat, the missing-verifier blocker, and the phase dependencies in no more than 2 pages.
items.notes: Wrote results/context_sync.md summarizing H1 as the only active lane, the malformed watchlist caveat, the missing-verifier gate, and stale saved-artifact inconsistencies.

items.description: Extend the saved literature snapshot with targeted web search for papers, code repositories, and state-of-the-art methods
items.acceptance_criteria: Reuse `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json` as the starting point, then extend it via targeted web search to include at least 10 relevant arithmetic-Kakeya or adjacent papers and at least 2 relevant code repositories or system references; each new entry must include title, year, venue or source, URL or identifier, a short why-it-matters note, and a tag such as `theory`, `adjacent`, `CA-method`, or `automated-search`.
items.notes: Extended results/literature/literature_snapshot.json with a curated 12-entry arithmetic-Kakeya/CA-adjacent layer based on exact-title Semantic Scholar retrieval plus targeted web searches, including 2 system references.

items.description: Create `sources.bib` and keep the prior-art gap analysis current
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `sources.bib` in the repo root with BibTeX entries for every consulted source and keep it synchronized with the extended snapshot; include at least 10 relevant papers, explicitly cite Katz-Tao (1999), Green-Ruzsa (2017), Cowen-Breen et al. (2020), Pohoata-Zakharov (2024), and Tao (2025), and update `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` with differentiation notes for each.
items.notes: Created sources.bib with 12 BibTeX entries from curated paper IDs and rewrote prior_art_gap.md with explicit differentiation notes for Katz-Tao, Green-Ruzsa, Cowen-Breen et al., Pohoata-Zakharov, Tao, and adjacent CA/automated-search references.

items.description: Run a multi-agent literature and novelty sweep, then seed the concept tree
items.acceptance_criteria: Use at least `explorer`, `citation_auditor`, and `integrator` to review the saved snapshot plus the targeted web results; write `results/swarm/phase_1_literature_synthesis.md` and create at least 3 concept cards under `results/concept_evolve/tree/phase_1_literature/` covering the champion lane, the strongest adjacent prior art, and the main novelty risk. The synthesis must explicitly compare the planned contribution against the watchlist papers '2x2-Convexifications for convex quadratic optimization with indicator variables', 'On Hopf hypersurfaces of the homogeneous nearly Kahler S^3 x S^3', and 'Continued A_2-fractions and singular functions', and explain why they are either false overlaps or genuine novelty constraints.
items.notes: Used explorer, citation_auditor, and integrator review passes; wrote phase_1_literature_synthesis.md and three concept cards under results/concept_evolve/tree/phase_1_literature/. The consensus was H1 stays champion, the watchlist trio are false overlaps, and the main risk is generic-search collapse.

items.description: Locate the exact verifier or log the blocker without inventing a replacement search stack
items.acceptance_criteria: Identify the repo or external entry point that exactly decodes and verifies `(X,G,R,T)` over Z, or write `results/verification/verification_summary.md` documenting that no such entry point is available in the current snapshot; include the shell-discovered paths checked and stop any implementation planning that would require an improvised verifier.
items.notes: Confirmed no exact (X,G,R,T) verifier or decoder in the repo snapshot or targeted public checks and wrote results/verification/verification_summary.md to keep experiment phases gated.

items.description: Specify the canonical witness schema, legality checks, and exact score accounting
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/baselines/witness_spec.md` describing the six-line witness format, product-grid encoding, legality constraints on `X`, `G`, `R`, and `T`, and the exact score `(m(G)+|R|)/(n(G)-|T|)`; include at least 5 worked validation checks that the future evaluator must enforce.
items.notes: Wrote results/baselines/witness_spec.md covering the six-line witness schema, legality constraints on X/G/R/T, exact score accounting, and six worked validation checks.

items.description: Define the matched baseline matrix and compute budget before experiments
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/baselines/benchmark_spec.md` defining at least 3 non-CA baselines (random local search, whole-witness mutation, and decoder-matched search), matched exact-decode budgets, matched `|X|` and edge-density budgets, and required reporting of hit rate plus full score distributions rather than best-of-many only.
items.notes: Defined the matched baseline matrix in results/baselines/benchmark_spec.md with three non-CA baselines, exact-decode parity, matched |X| and edge-density budgets, and mandatory distribution reporting.

items.description: Audit the baseline plan with specialist agents before any run
items.acceptance_criteria: Use at least `benchmark_auditor`, `falsifier`, and `integrator` to review the baseline matrix and controls; record a pass or fail checklist in `results/verification/baseline_audit.md` covering label shuffling, decoder leakage, compute parity, out-of-distribution grids, and rational-complexity sweeps.
items.notes: Recorded a conditional pre-run baseline audit in results/verification/baseline_audit.md covering label shuffling, decoder leakage, compute parity, OOD grids, and rational-complexity sweeps; execution remains verifier-blocked.

items.description: Explore baseline encodings inside the concept tree
items.acceptance_criteria: Create at least 3 concept cards under `results/concept_evolve/tree/phase_2_baselines/` comparing candidate CA state encodings or witness parameterizations; at least 1 card must be rejected explicitly for bounded-slope or low-rational-complexity risk, and 1 card must be promoted as the baseline-compatible encoding.
items.notes: Created three phase-2 baseline encoding cards under results/concept_evolve/tree/phase_2_baselines/, explicitly rejecting raw slope-species grids for bounded-slope risk and promoting macrocell fragment libraries as the baseline-compatible encoding.

items.description: Formalize the H1 proof-carrying symbolic forcing-front cellular automaton
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/core/h1_design.md` specifying the CA lattice or stage-indexed fiber layout, cell or state alphabet, proof-carrying symbolic fields, local update constraints, exact decoder interface, and the rule that candidates compile directly to legal `(X,G,R,T)` witnesses with no repair step.
items.notes: Wrote results/core/h1_design.md specifying the stage-indexed fiber layout, proof-carrying state fields, local legality constraints, exact decoder interface, and no-repair rule; the mandatory concept_evolve probe was launched but had not produced probe_result.json due a live retry/disconnect state.

items.description: Conduct a multi-agent H1 stress test before opening backup lanes
items.acceptance_criteria: Use at least `research_director`, `hypothesis_scout`, `falsifier`, and `integrator` to challenge the H1 design and record keep or kill criteria in `results/swarm/phase_3_h1_review.md`; the note must state that H2 opens only if H1 is killed or stalls after the first exact gate, and H3 remains reserve-only.
items.notes: Wrote results/swarm/phase_3_h1_review.md with keep/kill criteria for H1 and an explicit rule that H2 opens only if H1 is killed or stalls after the first exact gate, while H3 remains reserve-only.

items.description: Populate the core concept tree with champion, backup, and negative-control branches
items.acceptance_criteria: Create at least 5 concept cards under `results/concept_evolve/tree/phase_3_core/` covering H1 variants, the sparse-defect H2 backup, modular-shadow curriculum, neural-CA or reversible negative controls, and one explicit non-CA comparator; mark at least 2 branches as killed with concrete reasons and 1 branch as active.
items.notes: Created six phase_3_core branch notes covering active/held H1 variants, the H2 backup, killed modular-shadow and neural-CA branches, and an explicit non-CA comparator.

items.description: Maintain novelty differentiation against the real adjacent literature throughout core design
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` with phase-3 differentiation notes against Katz-Tao (1999), Green-Ruzsa (2017), Cowen-Breen et al. (2020), Pohoata-Zakharov (2024), Tao (2025), AlphaEvolve-style automated discovery papers, and Bond-Levine abelian-network papers; each note must say whether the overlap is mathematical, methodological, or only superficial.

items.description: Define backup-lane triggers and failure thresholds before search expands
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/core/lane_gates.md` listing the exact thresholds or observations that kill H1, open H2, or keep H3 closed; include label-shuffle collapse, out-of-distribution failure, decoder leakage, bounded-slope trapping, and missing-verifier conditions.

items.description: Run the first exact-verification H1 sweep on tiny legal grids
items.acceptance_criteria: If an exact verifier exists, evaluate at most 3 H1 local-rule families with at most 10^3 exact decodes per family on tiny legal `d1xd2` or `d1xd2xd3` grids; report hit rate, best verified score, median score, and failure reasons in `results/experiments/h1_tiny_grid_report.md`. If no verifier exists, replace the run with a blocker log that explicitly keeps later experiment phases closed.

items.description: Execute mandatory falsification controls for every promoted family
items.acceptance_criteria: For each promoted H1 family, run X-label shuffles at fixed geometry, a matched-budget non-CA baseline, a decoder-matched baseline, and held-out larger or different-aspect-ratio grids; summarize whether the signal collapses in `results/experiments/h1_controls.md` with per-control score distributions.

items.description: Measure complexity, alphabet, and modular-lift sensitivity before any claim of progress
items.acceptance_criteria: Run small-, medium-, and unrestricted-complexity `X` regimes plus any modular curriculum-to-integer lift checks; report score, hit rate, and lift success in `results/experiments/complexity_sweep.md`, and reject any story that wins only in bounded-slope or modular-only regimes.

items.description: Use specialist agents to audit experiment integrity and compute parity
items.acceptance_criteria: Use at least `monitor`, `benchmark_auditor`, `falsifier`, and `integrator` to audit the first experiment pass; write `results/verification/benchmark_report.md` confirming matched budgets, identical decoder usage, full score accounting, and whether negative results were preserved.

items.description: Produce novelty and citation verification artifacts before claiming progress
items.acceptance_criteria: Use at least `novelty_checker` and `citation_auditor` to create `results/verification/novelty_report.md`, `results/verification/citation_audit.md`, and an updated `results/verification/verification_summary.md`; the artifacts must explicitly state whether the observed behavior survives comparison against the named watchlist papers, the real adjacent arithmetic-Kakeya papers, and the CA or automated-search method papers.

items.description: Synthesize final results, blockers, and next decisions
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/final_assessment.md` summarizing whether the program found any exact verified witness progress toward score <= 1.675, whether the verifier blocker remained unresolved, and the concrete go, pivot, or stop decision with supporting evidence.

items.description: Freeze literature differentiation and bibliography in final form
items.acceptance_criteria: Before closeout, ensure `sources.bib` and `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` are updated to reflect the final chosen branch or blocker; include final differentiation notes against at least 10 cited sources and explicit comparisons to the strongest prior work actually used in phase-4 analysis.

items.description: Run a multi-agent final review of claims, evidence, and omissions
items.acceptance_criteria: Use at least `citation_auditor`, `benchmark_auditor`, `novelty_checker`, and `integrator` to produce `results/verification/final_audit.md` with pass or fail judgments on claim scope, citation support, compute parity, missing controls, and unresolved blockers.

items.description: Retrospect the concept tree and record killed branches
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/concept_evolve/tree/phase_5_retrospective/index.md` plus at least 3 branch notes summarizing killed ideas, surviving ideas, and unresolved questions; each note must trace back to one phase-3 or phase-4 artifact and state the dependency for any follow-up.

items.description: Prepare the publication-ready handoff package for writer and reviewer roles
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/writeup_outline.md` and ensure `results/verification/verification_summary.md` links the repo map, context sync, baseline spec, core design, experiment reports, concept-tree index, and final assessment; the handoff must be sufficient for a writer to draft a faithful report without reopening the search.
